name: Haus Maria
source:
After a disastrous experience of coming out to your family as a trans man, you find yourself alone at midnight, wandering the streets of Morcrest: a town home to the worshippers of Mor, the God Of Death.

Nobody will help you from fear of being cursed by Mor… except for a kind soul in a mansion on a hill, who conveniently lets you stay the night.

Of course, there’s a catch. But you don’t know that yet.

[From [url=https://beauvdalen.itch.io/haus-maria]itch.io[/url]]
